summaries.zh: claude-mem 是一个 TypeScript 项目，旨在为各类 AI 代理提供跨会话的持久上下文功能。该工具能捕捉代理在会话中的所有操作，通过 AI 进行压缩，并将相关上下文注入到未来的会话中。它兼容 Claude Code、Gemini、Copilot 等多种主流工具。目前该项目已获得超过 10 万 Star，显示出极高的社区关注度。
summaries.en: The `claude-mem` repository offers a tool designed to provide persistent context for AI agents across different sessions. It functions by capturing session activities, compressing the data using AI, and injecting relevant context back into future interactions. Written in TypeScript, the tool is compatible with a wide range of platforms, including Claude Code, Gemini, Copilot, and OpenCode. The project has garnered significant attention on GitHub, evidenced by its substantial number of stars and forks.

summaries.zh: Orkas 是一款开源（MIT 协议）、本地优先的桌面端 AI 团队工具。它通过“指挥官”将用户目标转化为待办事项，并协调 16 个内置专家代理及 Claude Code、Codex 等外部工具。该应用支持 macOS 和 Windows，提供免费下载，支持内置模型或自定义 API 密钥。项目基于 JavaScript 开发，目前在 GitHub 上已获得近 6000 星标。
summaries.en: Orkas is an open-source, local-first desktop application designed to function as an AI team. It features a "Commander" that transforms goals into tasks, coordinating 16 built-in specialist agents alongside integrations like Claude Code and Codex. The free tool, available for macOS and Windows, supports projects, scheduled automations, and connectors. Licensed under MIT and written in JavaScript, Orkas allows users to choose between built-in models or their own API keys. The project currently has over 5,900 stars on GitHub.
